walkthroughs.body_html:
Photosynthesis rate is limited by light, CO₂, or temperature.

Increase the limiting factor → rate rises. Once another factor is limiting, the rate plateaus.

Light intensity ∝ 1 ÷ d². Halve the distance, intensity rises ×4.

10 cm gives 100 units. 20 cm gives 100 ÷ 4 = 25 units.

Pondweed in NaHCO₃ solution. Count O₂ bubbles per minute at different lamp distances.

Mean rate = total bubbles ÷ minutes. Plot rate vs 1/d² for a straight line.

mcqs.q: Light is X units at 10 cm. At 20 cm it will be:
Which is NOT a limiting factor for photosynthesis?

options: Plants only photosynthesise and do not respire; respiration is for animals only.
Plants only respire at night and only photosynthesise during the day; the processes never overlap.
Plants gain most of their mass directly from sunlight, which has weight.
Yes — plants respire all the time to release energy; they also photosynthesise when there is light.

mcqs.q: Where do plants get most of their biomass from?
options: Plants only respire at night and only photosynthesise during the day; the processes never overlap.
Plants get most of their mass from the soil through their roots.
From carbon dioxide in the air — the carbon in plant tissue comes mostly from CO2 fixed during photosynthesis.
Plants gain most of their mass directly from sunlight, which has weight.

mcqs.q: What is the main role of mitochondria in a cell?
options: Mitochondria store sunlight and release it for photosynthesis.
Plants gain most of their mass directly from sunlight, which has weight.
To carry out aerobic respiration, producing ATP that cells use as an energy currency.
Mitochondria produce energy by creating it from nothing.
